title: Storyboard: the plan as Markdown behind a View plan button
description: The plan box showed one run-on line ([CAST]...[PANEL 1]...). The plan lands as Markdown (Cast / Places / Objects / Panel headings), a View plan button (disabled until a plan exists) opens it in the notes Markdown viewer/editor, and the idea box takes the freed height. The parser reads both the Markdown and the old bracket form. Post-2.1.3.
